note: Quoted from the Fish and Game Commission's Mammal Hunting and Trapping Regulations. take_kind is deliberately not uniform: a wild pig having no limit is a legal fact, and elk and bighorn take is set by the individual draw hunt rather than by a general bag limit.

records.limit_verbatim: The daily bag limit is one legal bear per day. The possession limit is twice the daily bag limit.
records.legal_take_verbatim: A legal bear is any bear, with the exception of cubs and females accompanied by cubs.

identification.definition_verbatim: A bear less than one year old or weighing less than 50 lbs.

warning.headline: Cubs and females with cubs are never legal.
warning.explanation: A legal bear is any bear except a cub or a female accompanied by cubs. A cub is a bear less than one year old or weighing less than 50 lbs. A sow with cubs is protected no matter her size.
